chunks: He may take a part and leave a part, but he does not have the right to forgo all of it.

key_terms.آخَرَ: another, indicating this report comes through a separate narration
key_terms.بَعْضًا: a part or portion, not the entirety
key_terms.خَبَرٍ: a narration or report transmitting the ruling
key_terms.كُلَّهُ: all of it; the whole amount or entirety under discussion
key_terms.يَأْخُذُ: he takes; meaning he may claim or receive a portion

ai.seo_question: Can a person take only part of a legal entitlement and leave the rest, or forgo all of it?
ai.summary: This narration conveys a legal ruling of partial entitlement or partial exercise of an option, while denying the permissibility of abandoning the entirety. In the chapter context, it relates to family law and the limits of a person's legal discretion regarding marital financial rights or obligations.
